holidays.name: Hexenstag
holidays.description: Witching day outside year — chaos risk
holidays.longDescription: Hexenstag is observed on day 32 of month 12 in the Old World Calendar. It is classified as a weird and is associated with Witching day outside year — chaos risk . Communities use the occasion to preserve local memory, reinforce shared identity, and mark the passage of the calendar year. Practices vary by region and faction, so this observance may carry different political or religious meaning across the wider world.
